text:
Alex K: :wave: Quick coordination — need to reshuffle the Wed RFC review (2pm PST). Two authors asked for swaps and I want to lock the agenda + pre-read reminders.

Alex K: Proposed new order (short meeting; 45m total). If you have constraints, reply with availability or +1 to confirm.
```
1) 2:00 — Maria L — infra metrics RFC (10m + 5m Q)
2) 2:15 — Devon P — KV cache proposal (15m + 5m Q)
3) 2:35 — Samir R — routing fallback patterns (10m + 5m Q)
``` 
Alex K: Pre-read checklist: link to PRs + 1 slide per author. Please post any blocking comments in the PR by Tue EOD. Pre-reads: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/infra-metrics, https://redwood.dev/rfcs/kv-cache, https://redwood.dev/rfcs/fallback-routing

Maria L: I'm good with 2:00. I'll drop a 1-slide summary by Tue noon. :+1:

Devon P: Can we flip 2 and 3? I have a customer call at 2:10 and might miss the start of mine.

Alex K: @Devon P flipping would make the timeline 2:00 Maria, 2:15 Samir, 2:30 Devon — still within 45m. Anyone opposed?

Samir R: I can do 2:15, happy to go earlier. If Devon needs buffer, +1 to swap. Also I'll post a short diag in the PR about latency impact.

Maria L: Swapping is fine by me as long as I'm first. :slightly_smiling_face:

Devon P: Thanks — 2:30 works. I'll aim for 10 mins talk + 5 Q. I'll pin the PR comment with the one-off perf table.

Alex K: Great. I'll update the calendar and send pre-read ping Wed morning. @Calendar Bot can you update the invite with new ordering and add the three PR links in the description?

Calendar Bot: Invite updated: "RFC Review — Wed" added agenda and links. :calendar:

Alex K: One more ask — reviewers, please skim the PRs before the meeting and leave at least 1 concrete question each so we can focus discussion.

Samir R: I'll leave 2 quick questions on Devon's PR. 

Maria L: I'll flag one edge-case on the metrics RFC.

Devon P: Ack. Also if anyone can't make the live call, record will be saved to the thread.

Alex K: Cool. If no objections by EOD Tue I'll book the swapped slots. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
